jobs.description: Do you want to be part of one of the fastest growing and fastest moving organizations inside the world’s most customer centric company? Do you enjoy breaking down and solving complex problems focusing first on our customer and working backwards? If so, Amazon Transportation Services is looking for a Carrier Manager responsible for the program management of border crossing operations, enabling the access of products from US Fulfillment to our customers in Mexico. The ideal candidate is able to drive 3P carrier performance for warehouse, sorting, imports, and transportation processes. The role is expected to drive continuous improvement and design operations that guarantee quality, speed, and cost to serve for our customers. Candidates for this role must be able to influence without authority while also driving 3P alignment to Amazon performance standards. This role is accountable for weekly and monthly business reviews for carrier performance. Candidate must also be able to influence internal stakeholders to drive end to end supply chain alignment considering complexities in border crossing operation. The ideal candidate is decisive and able to make decisions at critical times and whilst under pressure. You must be able to lead a carrier operation, be sensitive to the needs of customer, peers, and stakeholders, and demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-oriented work environment. Role is located in Amazon MEX16 in Mexico City with flexibility to travel to any US/MX border city such as Nuevo Laredo-Laredo, Tijuana-San Diego, Ciudad Juarez-El Paso. Key job responsibilities * Daily, Weekly and Monthly Business Reviews with carriers to ensure data-driven improvements * Drive continuous improvement projects in 3P managed operations * Execute tactical decisions for the benefit of customers * Understand customs and border crossing complexities to make the correct short term decisions, while designing long term solutions * Define mechanisms to audit and improve 3P performance * Document standard work and conduct training Candidates should exhibit the following trait: * Demonstrated strong negotiation skills through document writing and verbal communication * Strong knowledge of customs compliance and trade regulations, understanding the nuances and risks * Sound understanding of business financials, and ability to use data to drive cost improvements through efficiencies proposals or negotiations * Proven analytical and data driven skills, able to both drill down big data and complement with operational anecdotes to drive conclusions and actions

Riot engineers bring deep knowledge of specific technical areas, but also value the opportunity to work in a variety of broader domains. As Software Engineers, we work with both established and emerging technology, creating innovative solutions to overcome high-volume obstacles and to deliver value to our players.
Riot Client is the gateway for millions of players to play, discover, and install Riot games. Your work on the Client will be every single desktop players' first touchpoint with the wide range of experiences that Riot has to offer, including Riot’s culture & community, or getting into any of our games as fast as possible, like League of Legends, Wild Rift, Teamfight Tactics, VALORANT, Legends of Runeterra, 2XKO, and beyond. It is also an essential tool for internal game developers including live games and R&D games. Introduced in 2021, the multi-game Riot Client is becoming a destination for players to engage with Riot games, events and communities, and is a fast-evolving desktop software that provides capabilities in game distribution, content publishing, social and internal development efficiency.
As a
Senior Software Engineer
on the
Riot Client
team, you will deliver high-quality technical solutions that improve the player experience across Riot’s out-of-game ecosystem. You’ll contribute hands-on across the software development lifecycle, partnering closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and other cross-functional teammates to build reliable, scalable, and maintainable Client capabilities. You will help shape technical direction within your area of ownership, make sound implementation and design decisions, and collaborate with peers across Riot to support game distribution, content, social features, and developer productivity. Through strong engineering practices, thoughtful code reviews, and mentorship of other engineers, your work will help advance the next generation of Riot Client experiences for players and developers.
Responsibilities:
Develop and maintain desktop application features focusing on C++, with the ability to integrate with and contribute to web-based technologies
Deliver high-quality, scalable, and reliable engineering solutions within your area of ownership, through hands-on contribution and technical design
Contribute to technical planning and design discussions, helping evaluate tradeoffs between long-term sustainability and near-term delivery needs
Build and apply a strong understanding of the Riot Client’s dependency landscape, partnering with teams to align on technical solutions
Work closely with cross-functional partners, including product, production, QA, design, and data insight
Level up other engineers through mentorship and technical guidance
Required Qualifications:
6+ years of related industry experience
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or comparable experience in software development
Expertise with C++ in application development
Experience in web development
Experience working with complex code bases
Experience of cross-functional collaboration with product, design, and QA
Desired Qualifications:
Experience of working with desktop applications
Experience of working with Electron
Experience with build pipelines
For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes your fellow Rioters, who are the customers of your work. Being a dedicated fan of games is not necessary for this position!
Our Perks:
Riot focuses on work/life balance, shown by our open paid time off policy and other perks such as flexible work schedules. We offer medical, dental, and life insurance, parental leave for you, your spouse/domestic partner, and children, and a 401k with company match. Check out our
benefits pages
for more information.
At Riot Games, we
put players first
. That mission drives every decision in our quest to create games and experiences that make it better to be a player. Whether you’re working directly on a new player-facing experience or you’re supporting the company as a whole, everyone at Riot is part of our mission. And just like in our games, we’re better when we work together. Our goal is to create collaborative teams where you are empowered to bring your unique perspective everyday. If that sounds like the kind of place you want to work, we’re looking forward to your application.

쿠팡이츠 소개
쿠팡이츠는 다양한 맛집의 맛있는 음식은 물론 편의점, 마트, 꽃집 등 리테일 매장의 상품까지 여러분의 집 앞까지 빠르고 정확하게 배달해주는 쿠팡의 서비스입니다. 쿠팡이츠에서는 소비자, 배달파트너, 매장이라는 세 가지 고객군 모두에게 원활한 경험을 제공하기 위해 최선을 다하고 있습니다.
직무소개
쿠팡이츠 Visual Design 팀은 소비자, 배달파트너, 매장, 광고 비즈니스, 퀵커머스 등 다양한 제품과 비즈니스 영역 전반에서 시각적으로 일관된 고객 경험을 설계합니다.
시각적으로 일관된 고객 경험은 단순히 아름다운 화면이 아니라, 고객이 더 쉽고 빠르게 이해하고 행동할 수 있도록 도움으로써 제품의 신뢰를 높입니다.
Staff Product Visual Designer는
뛰어난 비주얼 디자인 역량을 바탕으로 기능이나 프로젝트를 넘어, 제품 전반에 걸친 시각적 경험을 발전시키며, 나아가 조직 전체의 비주얼 퀄리티를 지속적으로 높이는 역할을 합니다.
AI가
디자인 생산성을 빠르게 향상시키고 있지만, 문제를 정의하고 고객과 비즈니스의 목표를 이해한 뒤 적절한 해결 방법을 판단하는 일은 여전히 디자이너의 역할입니다. 우리 팀에서는 새로운 도구를 적극 활용하면서도 탁월한 디자인 판단으로 쿠팡이츠의 시각적으로 일관된 고객 경험
(Visual Customer Experience)을
리드할 디자이너를 찾고 있습니다.
주요 업무
쿠팡이츠 및 글로벌 제품에서 시각적 원칙과 다양한 디자인 접근을 활용해 고객이 더 쉽고 빠르게 이해하고 행동할 수 있는 시각적 경험을 구현합니다.
고객과 비즈니스 목표에 대한 깊은 이해를 바탕으로 가장 효과적인 시각적 솔루션을 제시합니다.
비주얼 디자인 원칙, 에셋, 가이드라인을 구축해 제품, 브랜드, 비즈니스 전반에서 일관된 비주얼 디자인 시스템을 만듭니다.
Product Designer, Product Manager, Engineer, Marketing, Business Strategy 등 다양한
이해관계자와 협업하며 복잡한 프로젝트를 운영 관리하고, 디자인 방향성과 의사결정을 리드합니다.
명확한 디자인 원칙을 통해 조직 전체의 비주얼 디자인 수준을 지속적으로 높입니다.
AI 기반 디자인 워크플로우와 새로운 디자인 도구를 적극 활용하여 반복적인 작업을 줄이고, 더 높은 수준의 문제 해결에 집중합니다.
디자인 리뷰, 멘토링, 프로젝트 리딩 등을 통해 다른 디자이너의 성장을 지원합니다.

Supersonic is one of the world's leading mobile game publishers, working with independent studios everywhere to turn promising ideas into games played by millions. Based in Tel Aviv and founded in 2020, the team has published more than 150 titles across the hybrid casual and casual space, backed by deep expertise in game analysis, monetisation and user acquisition. Role Overview
We are looking for a seasoned, hands-on Head of Engineering to drive technical excellence and lead Supersonic’s core development teams at scale. Acting as both a technical authority and people leader, you will manage multidisciplinary teams responsible for publishing SDKs, advanced level-generation tools, client-facing cloud integrations and multiple games.
You will oversee engineering execution and workflows across a diverse portfolio, including three core SDKs, two backend systems and multiple in-house games, while continually improving production pipelines. This is a highly strategic role requiring deep expertise in Unity performance, tooling and cross-team communication to ensure our portfolio can scale seamlessly for millions of daily active users.
This role will suit a hands-on, action-oriented leader who communicates clearly, stays open-minded and can move comfortably between code, architecture, people leadership, product priorities and business needs. The position is based in Tel Aviv, with four days per week in the office and Sunday working from home.
Key Responsibilities
Manage, mentor and develop three multidisciplinary teams comprising developers, QA engineers, technical artists and game designers.
Own technical direction, architecture, maintenance and execution across three core SDKs, two backend systems and multiple in-house games.
Remain hands-on with Unity development, acting as the technical authority for complex problem-solving, architecture and code where needed.
Take ownership of product needs as well as technical delivery, translating priorities from engineering, product and monetization stakeholders into clear, actionable roadmaps.
Drive the architecture and development of internal tooling, including custom Unity Editor scripts and algorithmic or procedural level-generation systems that empower game designers across projects.
Define, implement and continually improve engineering workflows, automation and CI/CD pipelines to enable rapid, stable game builds across the portfolio.
Oversee cloud and backend integrations that power critical, data-driven client features, bridging technical work across client, infrastructure and server-side teams.
Lead Unity performance and optimization strategies across mobile devices, including memory management, CPU/GPU profiling, load times and frame rates.
Support scalable LiveOps and data-driven feature deployment, including remote configuration and A/B testing, while serving as the central technical leader across engineering, product and monetization teams.
Required Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
10+ years of professional software-development experience, with a dominant focus on Unity, C# and mobile game production.
Expert-level knowledge of Unity, including custom Editor scripting, AssetBundles or Addressables, and extending the Unity pipeline.
A strong track record of managing, mentoring and scaling multidisciplinary engineering teams in a fast-paced, agile environment.
Strong experience developing clean, modular and reusable SDKs or packages used across multiple projects or a broad game portfolio.
Deep mobile LiveOps experience, including remote configuration, A/B testing frameworks and data-driven feature deployment; experience in hyper-casual or hybrid-casual development is valuable.
Hands-on experience building complex content tools, including level-generation or algorithmic layout systems.
Experience integrating cloud services or proprietary game servers to support live client features; familiarity with platforms such as Firebase, AWS or GCP is valuable.
Experience configuring and overseeing CI/CD pipelines for mobile game development using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions or Unity Build Automation.
Advanced Unity profiling and mobile optimization skills, including experience with Unity Profiler, Memory Profiler and Frame Debugger across low- and high-end devices.
Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to manage stakeholder expectations and lead effective cross-team workflows in English.

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

jobs.description: Annapurna Labs — Amazon's custom-silicon organization — is where a team of world-class engineers is shaping the future of cloud computing and AI. Here, hardware and software engineers collaborate side-by-side to bring Graviton, Trainium, Inferentia, and Nitro from bold idea to production silicon — solving problems no one else in the industry has tackled. You'll drive the workplace operations buildout — vendor relationships, event programming, process design, budget optimization, and employee experience — while simultaneously managing the operational excellence of a live, high-velocity engineering site. Partner with site leadership to develop the vision, mission and tenets for the site. Develop roadmap for site operations. Partner with Real Estate, Facilities, HR, Finance, IT, and Security to align site operations with business objectives. Communicate program status, wins, risks, and blockers through regular updates. Establish vendor performance metrics and conduct regular business reviews. Own site operations budget, analyze spending patterns, forecast quarterly and annual needs based on headcount growth. Event Operations & Execution Execute site events end-to-end: all-hands meetings, team celebrations, leadership offsites, press visits, intern programming, and social events. Collaborate with Public Relations on press visit plans. Oversee rehearsals, set-up, and breakdown of event spaces. Coordinate with Security for site security and e-waste coordination. Document event history through photos, videos, and archived project plans. Conduct post-event analysis including employee surveys and event-over-event insights. Drive continuous improvement utilizing AI and other tools to streamline reporting. Process Design & Scalability Design and document repeatable processes for site events, visitor hosting, meeting coordination, and workplace services. Day-to-Day Site & Meeting Operations Coordinate food and beverage ordering, inventory management, and restocking. Manage seating assignments, desk moves, and workspace allocation. Support leadership meetings: room booking, catering, AV setup, materials preparation. Manage conference room calendars and resolve scheduling conflicts for team events. Coordinate with Amazon shipping for handling incoming shipments. Maintain site communication channels (Slack, email lists, wiki pages). Communicate with Amazon’s global office team regarding all site management-related issues. A day in the life No two days look the same. You might start the morning reviewing vendor delivery confirmations and checking inventory levels for the week's food and beverage orders. Mid-morning, you're coordinating with catering and AV teams for an upcoming leadership offsite, confirming room configurations and finalizing the run-of-show. After lunch, you're walking the site with Amazon’s global office team, reviewing a space reconfiguration project and discussing upcoming capacity needs as the engineering team grows. Later, you lead a cross-functional planning session with site leadership on event programming — translating employee feedback data into a concrete calendar of engagement activities. You close the day reviewing your vendor performance dashboard, drafting a cost optimization proposal for the monthly business review, and sending a care package to a team member celebrating a milestone.
